high_level_description: The image shows a two-story building with a traditional European architectural style. The structure is made of stone and has a mix of exposed brickwork on the left side and plastered walls on the right side. The windows are rectangular and have wooden shutters; some shutters are open, while others are closed. The shutters on the right side are painted in a reddish-brown color, whereas those on the left side appear to be a darker shade, possibly black or dark brown. The building is situated in a green area with some plants and shrubs in front of it, suggesting a garden or yard.
